## 2000 - 2094

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02000">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2000 SRV - Low differential pressure as compared to previous record</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02000">

This validation and exception applies only to Orifice and Cone meters.

FLOWCAL will compare the Differential Pressure on the current record to the Differential Pressure on the previous record. An exception will be generated if the Differential Pressure has decreased by more than the minimum limit defined in the Single Run validation for Differential Pressure.

For example, the current record has a Differential Pressure value of 100. The Single Run validations are configured to always compare to the previous record using a minimum unit difference of 5. If the previous record's Differential Pressure is greater than 105, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

For example, the current record has a Mass value of 100000. The Single Run validations are configured to always compare to the prior day using a maximum unit difference of 5. If the prior day's Mass is less than 99995, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02032">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02049">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2049 Frozen value check</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02049">

This is a header exception; it is never generated within the application.

Frozen value exceptions are related to the limits that are defined in the Meter Editor (Setup \> Meter \> Editor). If a meter continues to report the same value for a particular data point over a number of hours, it is possible the reading is inaccurate and the results are caused by a frozen value that is not being updated. Meter frozen value validations allow the user to specify whether to look for frozen values, the number of hours for which each value must persist before it is considered frozen, and the limit for each value, which serves as a tolerance level within which values will be treated as identical.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02050">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02050">

This validation and exception applies only to imported data on orifice and cone meters.

FLOWCAL will compare the current record’s Differential Pressure to the Differential Pressure value on a specified number of prior hours. If the value on the specified records does not change by more than the user-defined limit, then an exception will be generated.

For example, if the Frozen Value comparison window is set to 2 hours and Differential Pressure Deadband is set to a difference of 1. The following samples will cause this exception to be generated on Periodic A.

Periodic A (08/01/2016 07:00:00): Differential Pressure = 85

Periodic B (08/01/2016 08:00:00): Differential Pressure = 85

Periodic C (08/01/2016 09:00:00): Differential Pressure = 85

</div>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02075">

Multi-run validation (MRV) exceptions are related to the limits defined in the Multiple Run subtab of the Meter Editor Validations tab for gas and liquid meters. Multiple run validation enables the user to perform a comparison of the meter’s record to as many as four other meter’s records for multi-tube locations, check meters versus sales meters, or upstream and downstream comparisons.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02076">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2076 MRV - Low differential pressure</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02076">

This exception is generated when the Differential Pressure on a periodic record falls below the lower bound calculated according to the values set in the Meter Editor. For example, for Meter One, the When field is set to Always; the Using field to Unit Difference; and the Min value to 0.1000 for Differential Pressure. If the Meter One’s periodic record at 8/1/2016 12:00:00 has Differential Pressure of 15.3 psi, the lower bound for the current meter’s differential pressure at 8/1/2016 12:00:00 is 15.3 - 0.1000 = 15.2 psi. If the differential pressure for that record is less than 15.2 psi, this exception will be generated for the periodic record.

The full Description of this exception will be: “MRV – low Differential Pressure as compared to Meter \#: \[comparison meter number\], \[current meter’s differential pressure\] -\> \[comparison meter’s differential pressure\]”

The validation field Differential Pressure and therefore this exception will be available only for Orifice and Cone meter types.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02077">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2077 MRV - Low pulses</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02077">

This exception is generated when the Pulses on a periodic record falls below the lower bound calculated according to the values set in the Meter Editor. For example, for Meter One, the When field is set to Always; the Using field to Unit Difference; and the Min value to 10.0000 for Pulses. If the Meter One’s periodic record at 8/1/2016 12:00:00 has Pulses of 1507, the lower bound for the current meter’s pulses at 8/1/2016 12:00:00 is 1507 - 10.0000 = 1497. If the pulses for that record is less than 1497, this exception will be generated for the periodic record.

The full Description of this exception will be: “MRV – low Pulses as compared to Meter \#: \[comparison meter number\], \[current meter’s pulses\] -\> \[comparison meter’s pulses\]”

The validation field Pulses and therefore this exception will be available only for Coriolis, Positive Displacement, Turbine, and Ultrasonic meter types.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02079">

If the Meter One’s periodic record at 8/1/2016 12:00:00 has Differential Pressure of 15.3 psi, the upper bound for the current meter’s differential pressure at 8/1/2016 12:00:00 is 15.3 + 0.1000 = 15.4 psi. If the differential pressure for that record is greater than 15.4 psi, this exception will be generated for the periodic record.

The full Description of this exception will be: “MRV – high Differential Pressure as compared to Meter \#: \[comparison meter number\], \[current meter’s differential pressure\] -\> \[comparison meter’s differential pressure\]”

The validation field Differential Pressure and therefore this exception will be available only for Orifice and Cone meter types.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02084">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2084 MRV - Low temperature</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02084">

This exception is generated when the Temperature on a periodic record falls below the lower bound calculated according to the values set in the Meter Editor. For example, for Meter One, the When field is set to Always; the Using field to Unit Difference; and the Min value to 0.1000 for Temperature. If the Meter One’s periodic record at 8/1/2016 12:00:00 has Temperature of 71.2°F, the lower bound for the current meter’s Temperature at 8/1/2016 12:00:00 is 71.2 - 0.1000 = 71.1°F. If the temperature for that record is less than 71.1°F, this exception will be generated for the periodic record.

The full Description of this exception will be: “MRV – low Temperature as compared to Meter \#: \[comparison meter number\], \[current meter’s temperature\] -\> \[comparison meter’s Temperature\]”

For liquid meters, Meter Temperature is the field that is applied with this validation and exception.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02090">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2090 MRV - Temperature differentiation violation</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02090">

This exception is generated when the difference between the current meter and another meter is less than the limit set for more than the duration configured in the Meter Editor. The When field for Temperature Differentiation needs to be set to Volume = 0 for this validation to run. One exception will be generated once on the first record only that meets the exception criteria if the violating condition continues for multiple consecutive records.

For example, for Meter One, the When field is set to Volume = 0; the Using field to Unit Difference; the Variance +/- value to 1.00; and the Duration value to 3 Hrs. Temperatures for the current meter and Meter One are as follows:

| Effective Date    | Current Meter | Meter One | Difference |
|:------------------|:-------------:|:---------:|:----------:|
| 9/1/2016 07:00:00 |     83.32     |   84.72   |    1.40    |
| 9/1/2016 08:00:00 |     76.86     |   77.62   |    0.76    |
| 9/1/2016 09:00:00 |     73.72     |   73.01   |   -0.71    |
| 9/1/2016 10:00:00 |     68.34     |   67.63   |   -0.71    |
| 9/1/2016 07:00:00 |     66.28     |   65.60   |   -0.68    |
| 9/1/2016 07:00:00 |     65.29     |   64.61   |   -0.68    |

The temperature difference is less than 1.00 starting on 9/1/2016 and for five consecutive hours. This exception will be generated for the periodic record at 9/1/2016 10:00:00.

If there is a gap in the current meter data, the gap will not be included in the duration count and will reset the count to 0.

The full Description of this exception will be: “MRV – Temperature Differentiation Violation, possible leak.”

</div>
